title: This Land Shark Crashed a Superhero Pool Party
description: Jeff the Land Shark gets his floaties on and heads to a pool party full of Marvel heroes. It goes about as well as you'd expect.
hook_note: A tiny cartoon shark in a Deadpool costume and snorkel goggles is an instant scroll-stopper before a single word lands.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: The motherfucking GOAT Jeff the Land Shark, and today he is going swimming.

segments.text: The motherfucking GOAT Jeff the Land Shark, and today he is going swimming.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: He has the goggles, the fins, and a Deadpool floaty, because the man has taste.

segments.text: He has the goggles, the fins, and a Deadpool floaty, because the man has taste.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: The destination is a superhero pool party, packed with half the Marvel roster.

segments.text: The destination is a superhero pool party, packed with half the Marvel roster.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And the little land shark pulls up dressed head to tail as Deadpool.

segments.text: And the little land shark pulls up dressed head to tail as Deadpool.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Right away he's mobbed like a celebrity, photos, ice cream, the works.

segments.text: Right away he's mobbed like a celebrity, photos, ice cream, the works.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: His floaty even has little Gwenpool logos on it, because of course it does.

segments.text: His floaty even has little Gwenpool logos on it, because of course it does.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Then the gear comes off, and a little fin slips into the water.

segments.text: Then the gear comes off, and a little fin slips into the water.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: For a moment Jeff just sits there, thoroughly pleased with himself.

segments.text: For a moment Jeff just sits there, thoroughly pleased with himself.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Then he hits the water, and he is having the time of his life.

segments.text: Then he hits the water, and he is having the time of his life.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Nobody down there notices the tiny shark weaving between their legs.

segments.text: Nobody down there notices the tiny shark weaving between their legs.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Everybody's relaxed, floating on donuts and pizza slices, not a care between them.

segments.text: Everybody's relaxed, floating on donuts and pizza slices, not a care between them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And then somebody spots a fin cutting through the water.

segments.text: And then somebody spots a fin cutting through the water.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: The whole pool empties in a panic, grown superheroes scrambling for the edge.

segments.text: The whole pool empties in a panic, grown superheroes scrambling for the edge.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: These people fight Galactus, and one baby shark fin has them climbing out of the pool.

segments.text: These people fight Galactus, and one baby shark fin has them climbing out of the pool.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Because down below, it's just Jeff, paddling around grinning like a maniac.

segments.text: Because down below, it's just Jeff, paddling around grinning like a maniac.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: He surfaces beside a unicorn float, tilts his head, and wonders what all the fuss is about.

segments.text: He surfaces beside a unicorn float, tilts his head, and wonders what all the fuss is about.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Meanwhile the mightiest heroes on Earth are cowering poolside from one very happy little shark.

segments.text: Meanwhile the mightiest heroes on Earth are cowering poolside from one very happy little shark.

cliffhanger_note: Will anyone tell the terrified heroes that the monster in their pool is just a delighted pet shark named Jeff?
